remainingScreenReaderReview.scope: Historical assessment below predates retirement. Current inventory is 11 Mac-eligible Guidepup cases; five unreliable cases retired with browser and scoped manual evidence on 2026-10-30. All 50 ticket mappings remain.
remainingScreenReaderReview.interpretation: Retain means the observable outcome justifies AT evidence, not that the test has passed or proves conformance. Strengthen means current assertions have a concrete false-pass, false-failure, scope, or cursor-start risk.

platformInventory.note: Ten retained cases have passing results across baseline/targeted runs. Deletion-dialog announcement is unresolved. No full green suite claimed; notification contamination limits one Array speech capture.

sharedRisks.finding: The helper returns a match from current item text OR last spoken phrase and resets to web-content root first. A matching prior/context phrase does not prove the cursor reached the named control.

The installed adapter exits focus mode, clicks/blurs the body, and navigates to page top. It establishes browse mode, but can change an already-open menu; calling it after opening an options list is not neutral.
NVDA itemText returns lastSpokenPhrase; it is not independent accessibility-node identity evidence.

This helper still sets DisableAutologin on all page requests. External font requests can receive that custom header and trigger CORS failures; this is a setup hazard, not proof of a password accessibility failure.
The Windows project uses Firefox, while many source reports specify NVDA with Chrome. Track exact reported-platform verification separately.
